_source: Aggregated_Aggregates_B2B_Bulk_Infrastructure_Pricing.xlsx — 'Category Markup Bands' sheet (September 2026), as transcribed in the delivered B2B build. Where a unit has no real benchmark its price is null and pricing_status says why; never fill one in without a supplier quote (AGENTIC_RULES.md rules 1 and 10).

products.name: Bulk Cement 42.5N
products.handling_notes: Store off the ground on pallets, under cover, away from moisture. Best used within 3 months of the manufacture date stamped on the bag.

units.source_note: No public bulk-bag benchmark found. Confirm with supplier before publishing a price.
No public tanker-load benchmark found. Confirm with supplier before publishing a price.

products.name: Bulk Cement 52.5N (Rapid Hardening)
typical_uses: Fast-track construction requiring early strength gain
products.handling_notes: Higher early-strength gain generates more heat of hydration — take care with large pours. Store cool, dry and off the ground, as with standard cement.

units.source_note: No public 52.5N-specific SA retail benchmark found. Confirm with supplier before publishing.
Same gap as the bagged unit. Confirm with supplier.

products.name: Road-Capping Binder (Fly Ash / Slag Blend)
products.handling_notes: Supplied in bulk for large-volume civil works. Mixing ratios are project- and soil-specific — confirm with the supplier or engineer before use.

units.source_note: Road-capping binders are sold bulk B2B, not bagged retail — quoted directly by the supplier.
Same gap as the bagged unit — quoted directly by the supplier.

products.name: Structural Non-Shrink Grout
products.handling_notes: Mix strictly to the manufacturer's water ratio on the technical data sheet. Pot life is short (typically 30–45 minutes) — mix only what can be placed immediately.

units.source_note: Pinnacle Construction Products, SikaGrout 212 25kg, Sep 2026 (listed R379–R426; R399 used as the midpoint).

products.name: Concrete Admixture — Accelerator
typical_uses: Cold-weather concreting to speed up set time
products.handling_notes: Dose per the manufacturer's technical data sheet (TDS) — overdosing can cause flash setting. Always trial-batch before full-scale use.

units.source_note: No public benchmark — bulk admixtures are quoted per project. A real supplier quote is needed before any price is published.

products.name: Concrete Admixture — Plasticizer
products.handling_notes: Add at the batching plant or on site per the TDS dosage. Store above freezing and stir before use if the product has settled.

units.source_note: Same gap as the accelerator — quote only until a real supplier quote is obtained.

products.name: Concrete Admixture — Retarder
typical_uses: Hot-weather concreting to delay set time
products.handling_notes: Overdosing can significantly delay strength gain — dose per the TDS and trial-batch for the site's ambient conditions.

units.source_note: Same gap as the accelerator — quote only until a real supplier quote is obtained.
